      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import seaborn as sns\n",
        "import warnings\n",
        "\n",
        "warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')\n",
        "sns.set_theme(style=\"whitegrid\", palette=\"muted\")\n",
        "plt.rcParams['figure.figsize'] = (14, 6)"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "print(\"Fetching live data from OWID...\")\n",
        "\n",
        "url_vacc = \"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/owid/covid-19-data/master/public/data/vaccinations/country_data/India.csv\"\n",
        "url_cases_full = \"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/owid/covid-19-data/master/public/data/owid-covid-data.csv\"\n",
        "\n",
        "df_vacc = pd.read_csv(url_vacc)\n",
        "\n",
        "df_cases_full = pd.read_csv(url_cases_full, usecols=['location', 'date', 'new_cases', 'total_cases'])\n",
        "df_cases = df_cases_full[df_cases_full['location'] == 'India'].copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"Vaccination data loaded: {df_vacc.shape}\")\n",
        "print(f\"Cases data loaded: {df_cases.shape}\")"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "UokSZdR4-iwe",
        "outputId": "7e0676e8-5b47-41c8-d9c6-d860bb47f5c8"
      },
      "execution_count": 2,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Fetching live data from OWID...\n",
            "Vaccination data loaded: (1250, 8)\n",
            "Cases data loaded: (1682, 4)\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "df_vacc['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df_vacc['date'])\n",
        "df_cases['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df_cases['date'])\n",
        "\n",
        "if 'people_fully_vaccinated' not in df_vacc.columns:\n",
        "    df_vacc['people_fully_vaccinated'] = np.nan\n",
        "\n",
        "df_vacc['total_vaccinations'] = df_vacc['total_vaccinations'].ffill().fillna(0)\n",
        "df_vacc['people_fully_vaccinated'] = df_vacc['people_fully_vaccinated'].ffill().fillna(0)\n",
        "\n",
        "df_vacc['daily_vaccinations'] = df_vacc['total_vaccinations'].diff().fillna(0)\n",
        "df_vacc.loc[df_vacc['daily_vaccinations'] < 0, 'daily_vaccinations'] = 0 # Remove negative anomalies\n",
        "\n",
        "df_cases['new_cases'] = df_cases['new_cases'].apply(lambda x: max(x, 0) if pd.notnull(x) else 0)\n",
        "df_cases['total_cases'] = df_cases['total_cases'].ffill().fillna(0)\n",
        "\n",
        "df_cases['new_cases_7d_avg'] = df_cases['new_cases'].rolling(window=7).mean().fillna(0)\n",
        "df_vacc['daily_vacc_7d_avg'] = df_vacc['daily_vaccinations'].rolling(window=7).mean().fillna(0)\n",
        "\n",
        "df_merged = pd.merge(df_cases, df_vacc, on='date', how='outer').sort_values('date').reset_index(drop=True)\n",
        "df_merged['location'] = 'India'\n",
        "\n",
        "df_merged.tail(3)"
      ],

      "source": [
        "fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 7))\n",
        "\n",
        "color = 'crimson'\n",
        "ax1.set_xlabel('Date', fontsize=12)\n",
        "ax1.set_ylabel('New Cases (7-Day Avg)', color=color, fontsize=12)\n",
        "line1 = ax1.plot(df_merged['date'], df_merged['new_cases_7d_avg'], color=color, linewidth=2.5, label='New Cases (Avg)')\n",
        "ax1.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor=color)\n",
        "\n",
        "ax2 = ax1.twinx()\n",
        "color = 'royalblue'\n",
        "ax2.set_ylabel('Fully Vaccinated People', color=color, fontsize=12)\n",
        "line2 = ax2.plot(df_merged['date'], df_merged['people_fully_vaccinated'], color=color, linewidth=2.5, label='Fully Vaccinated')\n",
        "ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor=color)\n",
        "ax2.fill_between(df_merged['date'], df_merged['people_fully_vaccinated'], color=color, alpha=0.1)\n",
        "\n",
        "lines = line1 + line2\n",
        "labels = [l.get_label() for l in lines]\n",
        "ax1.legend(lines, labels, loc='upper center', bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.1), ncol=2)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.title('COVID-19 Waves vs. Vaccination Rollout in India', fontsize=16, pad=15)\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()"
